name: Pixel 6 Pro
status: iOS 16.7.16 lock screen (2026-11-05, 8 CPUs; no touch yet)

notes.dram_banks: MEASURED on the phone (hardware/live-fdt-2026-11-05.txt, bootloader slider-1.3-11170084): three low /memory nodes with holes between them, listed as they are, and five contiguous 2 GiB nodes 0x880000000..0xb00000000, merged here into one 10 GiB bank (tools/mkpayload.py needs the kernel's RAM inside one bank). No fixed reserved-memory reg lies in the high range; eight dynamic pools (vframe, farawimg, ...) have alloc-ranges covering it, but no base: Linux allocates them, and bluejay's FDT shows the same pools.
notes.xnu_ram: guess: bluejay's proven 4 GiB at the start of the hole-free high range, 32 MiB aligned. The other 6 GiB of the high range stay unused until a larger size is tried under XNU.
notes.fb: read from source: Linux master d68ce4e71248 arch/arm64/boot/dts/exynos/google/gs101-raven.dts: cont_splash_mem reg <0xfac00000 (1440*3120*4)> = 0x1123800, simple-framebuffer 1440x3120, stride 1440*4, a8r8g8b8. The live FDT has no splash node (bluejay's neither); panel is samsung,s6e3hc3 (live FDT). OBSERVED on hardware 2026-11-05 (hardware/probe-run1-2026-11-05.txt): the shim drew its report on the panel with these values after DECON TRIG 0x3070 -> 0x3061.
notes.key_pins: read from source: identical to bluejay because all three keys are defined in gs101-pixel-common.dtsi (Linux master d68ce4e71248, gpio-keys :40-65, key_voldown gpa7-3 :806, key_volup gpa8-1 :813, key_power gpa10-1 :855), which gs101-raven.dts includes unchanged. Bank bases/offsets as bluejay's notes cite (pinctrl-exynos-arm64.c). Not observed on raven.
notes.key_active_low: read from source: GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW in gs101-pixel-common.dtsi :47 and following.
notes.userdata_mib: MEASURED on the phone: sysfs sda27 start 18321200, size 231248040 x 512 B = 28906005 x 4 KiB = 112914 MiB; first 4K block 0x22F1E6. Same geometry as bluejay's GPT read.
notes.usb_dma_range: MEASURED in the live FDT: reserved-memory abl@f8800000, no-map, 16 MiB, the same range bluejay's ABL reserves for its DWC3 event buffer. OBSERVED 2026-11-05: GEVNTADR 0xF8B9C000 lies inside it (hardware/probe-run1-2026-11-05.txt). Re-measure after a bootloader update.
notes.touch: MEASURED in the live FDT: Samsung S6SY79x (compatible sec,sec_ts, firmware s6sy79x.bin), not bluejay's ST FTM5, so no touch_* keys here: they would enable the FTM5 probe and driver against the wrong chip. Same wiring as bluejay: spi_11 at 0x10D40000, max 10 MHz, SPI mode 3 (cpol, cpha), gpp23-0..2 function 2, IRQ gpa9-0, reset gpp26-0, gpp26-1 (ap2aoc, bluejay's TS_SPI_SEL), rails S2MPG10 LDO25M/LDO26M, max-coords 1440x3120. One difference: raven's CS gpp23-3 is pin function 2 (hardware CS); bluejay's is a GPIO. A sec_ts driver is new work.
notes.phone_tools: tools/fboot.sh and tools/phone-guard refuse any product but bluejay (AGENTS.md hard rule 2). Booting raven needs that guard extended to raven in a reviewed change; until then the user runs fastboot by hand.
